name: Shay Boloor
zh_summary: S&P just revised $META credit outlook to negative and this Wedbush model shows exactly why. Meta’s compute capacity is projected to nearly quadruple to 26GW by 2030 on ~$1.2T in cumulative capex pushing annual depreciation to $171B without an established $AMZN, $GOOGL or $MSFT style cloud business to monetize that capacity. But I also think that’s where opportunity gets super interesting because Muse has over 25% of its weekly active users already shopping while Meta’s Business Agents handle over 30M customer conversations a week creating an opportunity for Meta to capture a share of transactions its AI agents facilitate.
